document.heading: Alternative Breakfast Service Model Emergency Amendment Act of 2026
To amend, on an emergency basis, the Healthy Schools Act of 2010 to modify the requirements for District school breakfast service.
document.text: BE IT ENACTED BY THE COUNCIL OF THE DISTRICT OF COLUMBIA, That this act may be cited as the "Alternative Breakfast Service Model Emergency Amendment Act of 2026".

section.text: The Healthy Schools Act of 2010, effective July 27, 2010 (D.C. Law 18-209; D.C. Official Code § 38-821.01 et seq.), is amended as follows:

para.text: Section 101(1B) (D.C. Official Code § 38-821.01(1B)) is amended to read as follows:
"Breakfast in the classroom" means an alternative breakfast serving model where students are served breakfast in the classroom.

codify:insert.text: *NOTE: This section includes amendments by emergency legislation that will expire on February 7, 2027. To view the text of this section after the expiration of all emergency and temporary legislation, click this link: Permanent Version.*

para.text: Section 203(a) (D.C. Official Code § 38-822.03(a)) is amended as follows:

Subparagraph (A) is amended by striking the phrase "breakfast in the classroom" and inserting the phrase "all students grab-and-go breakfast, breakfast in the classroom, or a combination of both breakfast models" in its place.

codify:find-replace.replace: all students grab-and-go breakfast, breakfast in the classroom, or a combination of both breakfast models

para.text: Subparagraph (C) is amended by striking the phrase "rate, without breakfast-in-the-classroom," and inserting the word "rate" in its place.

Subparagraph (A) is amended by striking the phrase "breakfast in the classroom" and inserting the phrase "grab-and-go breakfast, breakfast in the classroom, or a combination of both breakfast models" in its place.

codify:find-replace.replace: grab-and-go breakfast, breakfast in the classroom, or a combination of both breakfast models

para.text: Subparagraph (B) is amended by striking the phrase "breakfast in the classroom" and inserting the phrase "grab-and-go breakfast, breakfast in the classroom, or a combination of both breakfast models" in its place.

codify:find-replace.replace: grab-and-go breakfast, breakfast in the classroom, or a combination of both breakfast models

section.heading: Fiscal impact statement.
section.text: The Council adopts the fiscal impact statement of the Budget Director as the fiscal impact statement required by section 4a of the General Legislative Procedures Act of 1975, approved October 16, 2006 (120 Stat. 2038; D.C. Official Code § 1-301.47a).

section.heading: Effective date.
section.text: This act shall take effect following approval by the Mayor (or in the event of veto by the Mayor, action by the Council to override the veto), and shall remain in effect for no longer than 90 days, as provided for emergency acts of the Council of the District of Columbia in section 412(a) of the District of Columbia Home Rule Act, approved December 24, 1973 (87 Stat. 788; D.C. Official Code § 1-204.12(a)).
